sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: During this year's London Design Festival, plywood furniture specialist Lozi will debut a modular system, including clean-lined wardrobes and a fold-down bed, that aims to offer an affordable alternative to bespoke cabinetry. The idea for the collection emerged towards the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, when Lozi founder Soroush Pourhashemi received several requests from clients The post Lozi designs modular plywood furniture to make the most of compact bedrooms appeared first on Dezeen .
